dashboard.subtitle: Upload any document, the AI reads it, then you have a relaxed podcast-style conversation about your ideas.
dashboard.previewText: Upload a draft, the AI reads it, then you have a relaxed voice conversation about your ideas.

self.title: Start your own task
self.subtitle: Upload any document — a draft, slides, a summary or a position paper — and walk into a short podcast-style interview that surfaces how deeply you really understand it.
self.step1: Upload a document (PDF, DOCX or TXT — up to 25MB).
self.step2: The AI reads it and maps your key ideas.
self.step3: A minute later: a live conversation, not a test.

upload.title: What are we exploring today?
upload.subtitle: Your document stays private. Feel free to upload rough drafts — the AI handles them.
upload.tipBody: For long papers, you can upload just the section you'd like to talk about.

details.lecturerTipBody: Don't memorize answers. The interview rewards real thinking — pauses, course corrections, and "wait, let me reconsider" — all good signs.
details.fourSteps: Four steps. Most of it is just a conversation.
details.stepUploadDesc: Submit your draft (PDF, DOCX, or text).
details.stepAnalyzeDesc: The AI reads your work and surfaces the main ideas.
details.stepInterviewDesc: A calm voice conversation — about 12 minutes.
details.stepFinishDesc: That's it. Your submission receipt arrives by email.
details.pauseAnytime: You can pause and come back anytime.

upload.title: Drag your draft here.
upload.subtitle: PDF, DOCX, or TXT — up to 25 MB. The AI host will read it before the interview.
upload.orClick: or click to choose — we'll handle the rest
upload.draftEnoughBody: No need to polish — the AI reads ideas, not grammar. You can expand and refine your thinking out loud during the interview.
upload.errorTooLarge: This file is too large. Please upload a file up to 25 MB.
upload.errorUnsupported: Please upload a PDF, DOCX, or TXT file.
upload.errorGeneric: Upload failed. Please try again or contact your lecturer.

processing.title: One moment — the host is reading your work.
processing.subtitle: Usually takes about thirty seconds.
processing.errorBody: Please try again or contact your lecturer.

lobby.title: Your interview is ready.
lobby.subtitle: Take a deep breath. The AI host has read your draft and prepared a relaxed conversation around your ideas. About twelve minutes.
lobby.hostBio: Curious, patient, asks one good follow-up.
lobby.stopAnytime: You can pause or stop anytime.
lobby.tip1Body: A room with minimal background noise — no studio required.
lobby.tip2Body: Pauses, "wait, let me reconsider", and side notes — all welcome.
lobby.tip3Body: It's a conversation, not a recital. Trust your draft.
lobby.stuckBody: Say "I'm not sure" and Aria will rephrase or move on. No penalty.

micTest.title: Let's make sure Aria can hear you.
micTest.subtitle: Record a short clip and we'll listen together. About ten seconds.
micTest.permBody: Audio stays on your device until you submit the interview. We never record without your consent.
micTest.permDeniedBody: Please enable mic access in your browser settings to continue.
micTest.recording: Recording… say a sentence or two
micTest.tapToRecord: Tap the microphone to record a short clip

interview.thinkAloud: Pauses are good. Think out loud.
interview.leaveBody: Your progress may not be saved.
interview.greetingLine: The host is starting the interview. Speak naturally.

complete.title: Interview complete.
complete.subtitle: Beautiful work. The conversation is saved and on its way to your lecturer. Expect a response within five business days.
complete.scoringHint: We are grading your answers against the document — this takes about a minute.
complete.transcriptEmpty: No transcript was captured for this interview.

history.title: Assignment history
history.subtitle: Every interview you've completed.
history.empty: No completed interviews yet. After your first one, it will show up here.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Basic details that show up in interviews and reports.

help.title: Help center
help.subtitle: Everything to know before your first interview.
help.q1Body: The AI reads your draft and prepares open-ended, podcast-style questions. You answer aloud. No score, no right/wrong — just a relaxed chat.
help.q2Body: Make sure you allowed permissions in the browser and that no other app is using the mic. If it persists, return to the mic-test page.
help.q3Title: Which file types can I upload?
help.q3Body: PDF, DOCX, or TXT — up to 25 MB and 30 pages. PPTX, ZIP, and code files coming later.
help.q4Body: The conversation is delivered to your lecturer. You'll receive a submission receipt by email; the grade returns through your course's normal channel.

auth.title: Welcome back
auth.subtitle: Sign in to see your assignments.
auth.magicSent: We sent you a link — check your email.
auth.errorAnonymousDisabled: Anonymous sign-in is disabled in the project. Enable it in Supabase (Authentication → Providers → Anonymous) or sign in with email.
auth.guestHint: Anonymous session — real uploads and scoring, no email yet
